responsibility: Implements the machinery that rewrites function signatures, bodies, and call statements after IPA passes decide to remove, add, split, or replace parameters and optionally remove return values. It maintains per-edge modification summaries, collects formal parameter decls/types, transforms gimple calls and function bodies, remaps SSA names and debug binds, materializes synthesized parameters and split aggregates, and provides cleanup helpers for temporary edge-modification state. This is the execution engine shared by IPA-SRA, cloning, and related signature-changing transforms.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mechanics of applying parameter/signature changes to bodies and calls, including edge-modification summaries, formal-parameter collection, GIMPLE/SSA rewriting, debug-statement repair, and cleanup of temporary state. Unlike gcc/ipa-param-manipulation.h, it carries out the transformations rather than only declaring the adjustment classes and helper APIs.
